words.meaning: 생계 수단으로 (to earn money to buy the things you need)
words.example: What do you do for a living?

words.meaning: 전공하다 (to study something as your main subject at college)
words.example: She decided to major in engineering.

words.meaning: 직업, 경력 (a job or profession that someone does for a long period)
words.example: He is looking for a career in photography.
words.exampleKo: 그는 사진 분야에서 직업을 찾고 있다.

words.meaning: 조언 (suggestions about what you should do)
words.example: Can you give me some advice on my career?
words.exampleKo: 내 진로에 대해 조언을 좀 해줄 수 있니?

words.meaning: 전문적인 (relating to a job that needs special training)
words.example: You need professional training to be a pilot.

words.meaning: 기회를 잡다 (to do something even though it involves risk)
words.example: You should take a chance and follow your heart.
words.exampleKo: 너는 기회를 잡고 네 마음이 시키는 대로 해야 해.

words.meaning: 격려하다 (to give someone confidence or hope)
words.example: My parents encouraged me to pursue my dream.
words.exampleKo: 우리 부모님은 내가 꿈을 추구하도록 격려해 주셨다.

words.meaning: 따라가다, 따르다 (to go after or do as someone says)
words.example: Follow your dreams and never give up.
words.exampleKo: 너의 꿈을 따라가고 절대 포기하지 마라.

words.meaning: 영감 (a feeling that makes you want to do something)
words.example: Her speech gave me great inspiration.
words.exampleKo: 그녀의 연설은 나에게 큰 영감을 주었다.

words.meaning: 열정 (a very strong feeling of liking something)
words.example: He has a passion for music.
words.exampleKo: 그는 음악에 대한 열정을 갖고 있다.

words.meaning: 경험 / 경험하다 (knowledge or skill gained from doing things)
words.example: I have ten years of experience as a teacher.

words.meaning: 가능성 (the chance that something may happen)
words.example: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.

words.meaning: 도전 / 도전하다 (a new or difficult task that tests you)
words.example: Learning a new language is a challenge.
words.exampleKo: 새로운 언어를 배우는 것은 하나의 도전이다.

words.meaning: 안정된 (not likely to change or move)
words.example: She wants a stable job with steady income.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 꾸준한 수입이 있는 안정된 직업을 원한다.

words.meaning: 추구하다 (to try to achieve something over time)
words.example: He decided to pursue a career in law.

words.meaning: 앞으로 (toward the front)
words.example: She took a step forward.

words.meaning: 향상시키다, 개선하다 (to make or become better)
words.example: I want to improve my English skills.
words.exampleKo: 나는 내 영어 실력을 향상시키고 싶다.

words.meaning: 편안한 (feeling physically relaxed and at ease)
words.example: This sofa is very comfortable.

words.meaning: 목표 (something you are trying to achieve)
words.example: My goal is to become a doctor.

words.meaning: 결정 (a choice you make after thinking carefully)
words.example: It was a difficult decision to make.

words.meaning: 성취하다, 이루다 (to succeed in finishing something or reaching a goal)
words.example: They worked hard to achieve their goals.
words.exampleKo: 그들은 목표를 달성하기 위해 열심히 노력했다.

words.meaning: 영향을 미치다 (to cause a change in someone or something)
words.example: The weather can affect our mood.
words.exampleKo: 날씨는 우리의 기분에 영향을 미칠 수 있다.

words.meaning: 자신감 (the feeling that you can do something well)
words.example: She spoke with great confidence.

words.meaning: 사진사 (someone whose job is to take photos)
words.example: She works as a photographer for a magazine.

words.meaning: 공학 (the work of designing machines, roads, and bridges)
words.example: He is studying engineering at university.

words.meaning: 평범한 (not special or unusual)
words.example: It was just an ordinary day.

words.meaning: 학위 (a qualification given after a university course)
words.example: She earned a degree in biology.

words.meaning: 반면에, 한편 (used to give a different opinion or fact)
words.example: The job is hard. On the other hand, the pay is good.
words.exampleKo: 그 일은 힘들다. 반면에 월급은 좋다.

words.meaning: 재능 (a natural ability to do something well)
words.example: She has a talent for drawing.

words.meaning: 두려워하는, 겁먹은 (feeling afraid)
words.example: The child was frightened by the loud noise.
words.exampleKo: 그 아이는 큰 소리에 겁을 먹었다.

words.meaning: 깨닫다 (to understand or know something clearly)
words.example: I realized I had forgotten my keys.
words.exampleKo: 나는 열쇠를 두고 온 것을 깨달았다.

words.meaning: 대담한, 용감한 (brave and willing to take risks)
words.example: She made a bold decision to quit her job.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 직장을 그만두는 대담한 결정을 내렸다.

words.meaning: ~덕분에 (because of someone or something)
words.example: Thanks to your help, I finished the project on time.
words.exampleKo: 너의 도움 덕분에 프로젝트를 제때 마쳤어.

words.meaning: 껍데기, 껍질 (the hard outer covering of a nut, egg, or sea creature)
words.example: She painted the seashell in bright colors.

words.meaning: 비슷한 (almost the same but not exactly)
words.example: Our tastes in music are similar.

words.meaning: 표현 (a word or phrase used to show what you mean)
words.example: "Break a leg" is a common English expression.

words.meaning: 사라지다 (to go out of sight)
words.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.

words.meaning: 국제적인 (involving more than one country)
words.example: She works for an international company.

words.meaning: 만족시키다 (to make someone pleased)
words.example: This meal will satisfy your hunger.
words.exampleKo: 이 음식은 너의 배고픔을 만족시킬 것이다.

words.word: not only A but also B
words.meaning: A뿐만 아니라 B도 (used to add another item or idea)
words.example: She is not only smart but also kind.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 똑똑할 뿐만 아니라 친절하기도 하다.

words.meaning: A에게 B를 떠올리게 하다 (to make someone think of something)
words.example: This song reminds me of my childhood.
words.exampleKo: 이 노래는 나에게 어린 시절을 떠올리게 한다.

words.meaning: 꽃을 피우다 (for a tree or plant to produce flowers)
words.example: Cherry trees blossom in spring.

words.meaning: 따뜻하게 하다 (to make or become warm)
words.example: She warmed her hands by the fire.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 불 옆에서 손을 따뜻하게 했다.

words.meaning: 팬케이크 (a thin flat cake cooked in a pan)
words.example: We had pancakes for breakfast.

words.meaning: 한 입 베어 물다 (to bite a small piece of food)
words.example: He took a bite of the apple.
words.exampleKo: 그는 사과를 한 입 베어 물었다.

words.meaning: 전통적인 (following customs that have existed for a long time)
words.example: Kimchi is a traditional Korean food.

words.meaning: 요리법, 레시피 (instructions for cooking a dish)
words.example: I got this recipe from my grandmother.

words.meaning: 기분이 나아지다 (to become less sick or sad)
words.example: After the walk I felt better.

words.meaning: 카사바 (a tropical plant with a starchy root, used as food)
words.example: Cassava is a popular food in many African countries.
words.exampleKo: 카사바는 많은 아프리카 국가에서 인기 있는 음식이다.

words.meaning: ~로 가득 차다 (to be full of something)
words.example: Her heart was filled with joy.

words.meaning: 추천하다 (to suggest something as good)
words.example: Can you recommend a good book?
words.exampleKo: 좋은 책을 추천해 줄 수 있니?

words.meaning: 기억, 추억 (something that you remember from the past)
words.example: I have happy memories of my school days.
words.exampleKo: 나는 학창 시절에 대한 행복한 추억이 있다.

words.meaning: 상기시키다 (to make someone think of something again)
words.example: This soup reminds me of my grandmother.
words.exampleKo: 이 수프는 우리 할머니를 생각나게 한다.

words.meaning: 위, 배 (the part of your body where food is digested)
words.example: My stomach hurts.

words.meaning: 맛, 향 (the particular taste of a food or drink)
words.example: This ice cream has a strawberry flavor.

words.meaning: 바삭한 (hard and easy to break into small pieces)
words.example: I love crispy fried chicken.

words.meaning: 마들렌 (a small shell-shaped sponge cake from France)
words.example: She baked madelines for tea time.

words.meaning: 특정한, 구체적인 (clear and detailed)
words.example: Please give me a specific example.

words.meaning: 마음을 편하게 해주는 음식 (food that gives you a warm, good feeling)
words.example: Chicken soup is my favorite comfort food.
words.exampleKo: 치킨 수프는 내가 가장 좋아하는 컴포트 푸드이다.

words.meaning: 다시 떠올리게 하다 (to cause someone to remember something)
words.example: This photo brings back wonderful memories.
words.exampleKo: 이 사진은 멋진 추억을 다시 떠올리게 한다.

words.meaning: 재료 (one of the foods used to make a dish)
words.example: Flour is the main ingredient of bread.

words.meaning: 스트레스가 많은 (making you feel worried and tense)
words.example: Final exams can be very stressful.
words.exampleKo: 기말고사는 매우 스트레스가 많을 수 있다.

words.meaning: 구슬 (a small ball with a hole, used to make jewelry)
words.example: She wore a necklace made of glass beads.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 유리 구슬로 만든 목걸이를 하고 있었다.

words.meaning: 오염 (harmful substances in the air, water, or soil)
words.example: Air pollution is a serious problem.

words.meaning: A를 B로 바꾸다 (to change one thing into another)
words.example: They turn old bottles into new products.
words.exampleKo: 그들은 낡은 병을 새로운 제품으로 바꾼다.

words.meaning: 버리다 (to throw away something you no longer want)
words.example: Please do not discard plastic on the street.

words.meaning: 제품, 상품 (something that is made or grown to be sold)
words.example: This product is made from recycled paper.

words.meaning: 요약하면, 간단히 말해서 (used to give a short summary)
words.example: In short, we need to act now.
words.exampleKo: 간단히 말해서, 우리는 지금 행동해야 한다.

words.meaning: 환경 (the air, water, and land in which people, animals, and plants live)
words.example: We must take action to protect the environment.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 환경을 보호하기 위해 조치를 취해야 한다.

words.meaning: 쓰레기, 낭비 (things that are no longer useful or needed)
words.example: We should reduce food waste at home.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 집에서 음식물 쓰레기를 줄여야 한다.

words.meaning: 행성 (a large round object in space that moves around a star)
words.example: Earth is the only planet known to support life.
words.exampleKo: 지구는 생명을 지탱하는 것으로 알려진 유일한 행성이다.

words.meaning: ~ 대신에 (in place of something or someone)
words.example: I drank tea instead of coffee.

words.meaning: 영향 (a strong effect on someone or something)
words.example: Plastic has a bad impact on the ocean.

words.meaning: 해로운 (causing damage or injury)
words.example: Smoking is harmful to your health.

words.meaning: 보호하다 (to keep someone or something safe)
words.example: We must protect endangered animals.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 멸종 위기에 처한 동물들을 보호해야 한다.

words.meaning: 초래하다, 일으키다 (to cause something to happen)
words.example: The new policy brought about many changes.

words.meaning: 재사용 가능한 (able to be used again)
words.example: Please use reusable bags when shopping.
words.exampleKo: 쇼핑할 때 재사용 가능한 가방을 사용해 주세요.

words.meaning: 재활용하다 (to treat used items so they can be used again)
words.example: We recycle paper, plastic, and glass.

words.meaning: 줄이다 (to make something smaller in amount)
words.example: We need to reduce our energy use.

words.meaning: ~에 참여하다 (to take part in an activity)
words.example: Many students participated in the clean-up event.

words.meaning: 작은 비닐봉지 (a small plastic bag)
words.example: She packed cookies in a baggie for her lunch.

words.meaning: 조치를 취하다, 행동에 나서다 (to do something to deal with a problem)
words.example: We must take action to stop climate change.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 기후 변화를 막기 위해 행동에 나서야 한다.

words.meaning: 창의적인 (good at making new things or ideas)
words.example: She has a very creative mind.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 매우 창의적인 사고방식을 지니고 있다.

words.meaning: 결국 ~하게 되다 (to reach a place or situation after some time)
words.example: Many plastic bottles end up in the ocean.
words.exampleKo: 많은 플라스틱 병들이 결국 바다로 흘러 들어간다.

words.meaning: 자원 (something valuable that a country or person has)
words.example: Water is a precious natural resource.

words.meaning: 과정 (a series of actions taken to achieve something)
words.example: Recycling is a simple process.

words.meaning: 업사이클하다 (to make new objects out of old or used things)
words.example: She upcycled old jeans into a stylish bag.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 낡은 청바지를 멋진 가방으로 업사이클했다.

words.meaning: 유용한 (helpful for a particular purpose)
words.example: This app is very useful for learning English.
words.exampleKo: 이 앱은 영어를 배우는 데 매우 유용하다.

words.meaning: 변화를 만들다, 영향을 주다 (to cause an important change)
words.example: One person can make a difference.
words.exampleKo: 한 사람이 변화를 만들 수 있다.

words.meaning: 가치 있는, 귀중한 (worth a lot of money or very useful)
words.example: This ring is very valuable.

words.meaning: 재료, 소재 (the substance that something is made from)
words.example: Wood is a common building material.

words.meaning: 전시회 (a public show of art or other objects)
words.example: We visited the art exhibition last weekend.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 지난 주말에 미술 전시회에 갔다.

words.meaning: 버리다 (to get rid of something you don't need)
words.example: Don't throw away those old clothes.

words.meaning: ~을 찾다 (to try to find something)
words.example: He is searching for his lost keys.

words.meaning: 역사적인 (relating to the past)
words.example: Gyeongbokgung is a famous historical site.

words.meaning: ~에 헌신하다, 전념하다 (to give all your time and effort to something)
words.example: She is dedicated to helping others.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 다른 사람들을 돕는 일에 헌신하고 있다.

words.meaning: 돌보다, 좋아하다 (to look after someone or something)
words.example: Nurses care for sick people.

words.meaning: 가치 (the importance or worth of something)
words.example: This old book has great historical value.
words.exampleKo: 이 오래된 책은 큰 역사적 가치가 있다.

words.meaning: 정체성 (who a person is, or the qualities that make them)
words.example: Language is an important part of our identity.

words.meaning: 박물관 (a building where important objects are shown)
words.example: The museum has many ancient artifacts.
words.exampleKo: 그 박물관은 많은 고대 유물을 소장하고 있다.

words.meaning: 기록 / 기록하다 (information stored so it can be looked at later)
words.example: She kept a record of every book she read.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 읽은 모든 책의 기록을 남겼다.

words.meaning: ~에서 역할을 하다 (to be involved in something)
words.example: Education plays a key role in success.

words.meaning: 포기하다 (to stop trying)
words.example: Don't give up on your dreams.

words.meaning: 유물, 공예품 (an object made by humans long ago)
words.example: The museum displays ancient artifacts.
words.exampleKo: 그 박물관은 고대 유물을 전시하고 있다.

words.meaning: 유산 (features belonging to the culture of a society, such as traditions)
words.example: We should take pride in our cultural heritage.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 우리의 문화유산에 자부심을 가져야 한다.

words.meaning: 수집품, 컬렉션 (a group of similar things kept together)
words.example: He has a large stamp collection.
words.exampleKo: 그는 많은 우표 수집품을 가지고 있다.

words.meaning: 문서, 서류 (an official paper with information)
words.example: Please sign this document.

words.meaning: 발견하다 (to find something for the first time)
words.example: Scientists discovered a new species of fish.

words.meaning: 영향 / 영향을 주다 (the power to affect someone or something)
words.example: His teacher had a big influence on him.
words.exampleKo: 그의 선생님은 그에게 큰 영향을 미쳤다.

words.meaning: 고군분투하다, 애쓰다 (to try very hard to do something difficult)
words.example: He struggled to finish the marathon.

words.meaning: 물려주다, 전수하다 (to give from older to younger generations)
words.example: This recipe was passed down from my grandmother.

words.meaning: ~에 속하다, ~의 것이다 (to be the property or a member of)
words.example: This book belongs to me.

words.meaning: 문화 (the beliefs, customs, and arts of a society)
words.example: Korean culture is known worldwide.
words.exampleKo: 한국 문화는 전 세계적으로 알려져 있다.

words.meaning: 고대의, 아주 오래된 (belonging to a time long ago)
words.example: We visited an ancient temple in the mountains.

words.meaning: 돌아오다, 돌려주다 (to come back or give back)
words.example: Please return the book to the library.

words.meaning: 국가의, 국립의 (connected with a particular nation)
words.example: We visited the national museum.

words.meaning: 보존하다 (to keep something in its original state)
words.example: We must preserve our cultural heritage.

words.meaning: 귀중한, 소중한 (very valuable or important)
words.example: Time with family is precious.

words.meaning: 상징 (a sign or object that represents something)
words.example: The dove is a symbol of peace.

words.meaning: 해결하다, 풀다 (to find an answer to a problem)
words.example: We worked together to solve the problem.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 문제를 해결하기 위해 함께 일했다.

words.meaning: 다양한 (very different from each other)
words.example: Our class has students from diverse backgrounds.
words.exampleKo: 우리 반에는 다양한 배경의 학생들이 있다.

words.meaning: 오해하다 (to understand something wrongly)
words.example: Please don't misunderstand what I said.

words.meaning: 의사소통 (sharing information with others)
words.example: Good communication is the key to success.

words.meaning: 다시 말해서, 즉 (used to explain something in a different way)
words.example: He is too busy; in other words, he can't join us.
words.exampleKo: 그는 너무 바쁘다. 다시 말해, 우리와 함께할 수 없다.

words.meaning: 갈등, 충돌 (a serious disagreement)
words.example: They had a conflict about money.

words.meaning: 태도 (how you think or feel about something)
words.example: She has a positive attitude toward life.
words.exampleKo: 그녀는 삶에 대해 긍정적인 태도를 가지고 있다.

words.meaning: 활동적인, 적극적인 (doing things or moving a lot)
words.example: My grandmother is very active for her age.
words.exampleKo: 우리 할머니는 연세에 비해 아주 활동적이시다.

words.meaning: ~에 주의를 기울이다 (to watch or listen carefully)
words.example: Please pay attention to the teacher.

words.meaning: 관점 (a particular way of considering something)
words.example: Traveling helps you see things from a different perspective.
words.exampleKo: 여행은 사물을 다른 관점에서 볼 수 있게 도와준다.

words.meaning: 받아들이다, 수락하다 (to agree to take or receive something)
words.example: She accepted his apology.

words.meaning: 표현하다 (to show what you think or feel)
words.example: He found it hard to express his feelings.
words.exampleKo: 그는 자신의 감정을 표현하는 것이 어렵다고 느꼈다.

words.meaning: 반응 (something you do or say because of what happened)
words.example: Her reaction to the news was surprising.
words.exampleKo: 그 소식에 대한 그녀의 반응은 놀라웠다.

words.meaning: 지지하다, 돕다 (to help or encourage someone)
words.example: My parents always support my decisions.
words.exampleKo: 우리 부모님은 언제나 내 결정을 지지해 주신다.

words.meaning: 역지사지하다 (to imagine how someone else feels in a difficult situation)
words.example: Before you judge him, try to put yourself in his shoes.
words.exampleKo: 그를 판단하기 전에, 그의 입장이 되어 보렴.

words.meaning: 관계 (the way two people or groups behave toward each other)
words.example: They have a close relationship.

words.meaning: 공감, 감정이입 (the ability to understand how someone else feels)
words.example: A good leader needs empathy.

words.meaning: ~에 동의하다 (to have the same opinion as someone)
words.example: I agree with your idea.

words.meaning: 상황 (all the things that are happening at a certain time)
words.example: It was a difficult situation.

words.meaning: ~와 잘 지내다 (to have a good relationship with someone)
words.example: I get along well with my classmates.

words.meaning: 차이 (the way in which things are not the same)
words.example: There is a big difference between the two.
words.exampleKo: 그 둘 사이에는 큰 차이가 있다.

words.meaning: 의견 (what you think about something)
words.example: Everyone has a right to their opinion.
words.exampleKo: 모든 사람은 자신의 의견을 가질 권리가 있다.

words.meaning: 존중하다 (to admire someone and treat them well)
words.example: We should respect other people's opinions.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 다른 사람의 의견을 존중해야 한다.

words.meaning: ~에 집중하다 (to give special attention to something)
words.example: Let's focus on the most important issue.

words.meaning: 자동화 (the use of machines to do work automatically)
words.example: Automation is changing the workplace.

words.meaning: 책임 (a duty to deal with something)
words.example: It is your responsibility to clean your room.
words.exampleKo: 네 방을 청소하는 것은 네 책임이다.

words.meaning: 한계, 제한 (the greatest amount allowed)
words.example: There is a time limit for this test.

words.meaning: 기술 (the use of science for practical purposes)
words.example: Modern technology has changed our lives.

words.meaning: 안전 (the state of being safe)
words.example: Safety is our top priority.

words.meaning: 수행하다, 공연하다 (to do a task, or play music for people)
words.example: Robots can perform dangerous tasks.
words.exampleKo: 로봇은 위험한 일을 수행할 수 있다.

words.meaning: ~을 생각해 내다, 떠올리다 (to think of an idea or plan)
words.example: She came up with a great idea.

words.meaning: 더 이상 ~않다 (not any more)
words.example: He no longer lives here.
words.exampleKo: 그는 더 이상 여기에 살지 않는다.

words.meaning: 미래 (the time that will come)
words.example: I am excited about the future.

words.meaning: 진단 (a doctor's judgment about what illness someone has)
words.example: The doctor gave a quick diagnosis.

words.meaning: 효율적인 (working well without wasting time or energy)
words.example: This machine is very efficient.

words.meaning: 혁신 (a new idea, method, or invention)
words.example: The smartphone was a great innovation.

words.meaning: 이익, 혜택 (an advantage or good result)
words.example: Exercise has many health benefits.

words.meaning: 윤리적인 (relating to right and wrong)
words.example: It is an ethical question.

words.meaning: 인공의, 인조의 (made by people, not natural)
words.example: Artificial intelligence is developing fast.

words.meaning: ~에 상관없이 (without considering something)
words.example: Everyone is welcome, regardless of age.

words.meaning: 대체하다, 교체하다 (to take the place of someone or something)
words.example: Machines may replace many human jobs.
words.exampleKo: 기계가 많은 사람의 일자리를 대체할지도 모른다.

words.meaning: 발전, 개발 (the process of growing or becoming better)
words.example: The development of AI is rapid.

words.meaning: ~을 이용하다 (to use something for a purpose)
words.example: We should make use of new technology.

words.meaning: ~에 적용되다, 지원하다 (to be relevant, or to send a formal request)
words.example: The rule applies to everyone.

words.meaning: 편리한 (easy to use or suitable for your needs)
words.example: Online shopping is very convenient.

words.meaning: 의료의, 의학의 (relating to medicine)
words.example: He works in the medical field.

words.meaning: 정확성 (the quality of being correct or exact)
words.example: Accuracy is important in science.

words.meaning: 산업 (the production of goods or services)
words.example: The car industry is very competitive.

words.meaning: 항해, 긴 여행 (a long trip by sea or in space)
words.example: Columbus made a long voyage across the ocean.
words.exampleKo: 콜럼버스는 바다를 건너는 긴 항해를 했다.

words.meaning: 중요한, 의미 있는 (important or large enough to be noticed)
words.example: It was a significant moment in history.

words.meaning: 존경하다, 감탄하다 (to respect and like someone greatly)
words.example: I admire her courage.

words.meaning: ~을 기리기 위해 (to show respect for someone or something)
words.example: The museum was built in honor of the hero.
words.exampleKo: 그 박물관은 영웅을 기리기 위해 지어졌다.

words.meaning: ~을 위해 분투하다 (to fight hard to get something)
words.example: They struggled for freedom.

words.meaning: 정복하다 (to take control of a place by force)
words.example: Napoleon tried to conquer Europe.

words.meaning: 출발하다 (to start a journey)
words.example: We set off early in the morning.

words.meaning: 여행, 여정 (the act of traveling from one place to another)
words.example: It was a long journey across the country.

words.meaning: 경로, 길 (a way from one place to another)
words.example: We took the shortest route home.
words.exampleKo: 우리는 가장 짧은 경로로 집에 갔다.

words.meaning: 제국 (a group of countries ruled by one government)
words.example: The Roman Empire lasted for centuries.

words.meaning: 혁명 (a big change in government or society)
words.example: The French Revolution changed the country.

words.meaning: 승리, 대성공 (a great success)
words.example: The team celebrated their triumph.

words.meaning: 살아남다 (to continue to live or exist)
words.example: Only a few people survived the storm.

words.meaning: ~을 자랑스러워하다 (to feel pleased about something)
words.example: I am proud of my sister.

words.meaning: 용기, 용감함 (courage in facing danger)
words.example: The soldier was praised for his bravery.

words.meaning: 전설적인 (very famous and admired)
words.example: She is a legendary singer.

words.meaning: 탐험가 (someone who travels to unknown places)
words.example: Magellan was a famous explorer.

words.meaning: 독립 (freedom from being governed or ruled by another country)
words.example: Korea celebrated its independence in 1945.

words.meaning: 발견 (the act of finding something for the first time)
words.example: The discovery of DNA changed science.

words.meaning: 모험 (an exciting or dangerous experience)
words.example: Our trip was a big adventure.

words.meaning: 기념비, 기념물 (a structure built to remember a person or event)
words.example: The monument stands in the city center.

words.meaning: 고전적인, 전형적인 (typical and a good example of something)
words.example: This is a classic movie from the 1950s.

words.meaning: 창의성 (the ability to make new things or ideas)
words.example: Art classes help develop creativity.
words.exampleKo: 미술 수업은 창의성을 기르는 데 도움이 된다.

words.meaning: 공연, 수행 (the act of showing a play, music, etc.)
words.example: The band gave a great performance.

words.meaning: 풍경, 풍경화 (a view of the countryside, or a painting of it)
words.example: She painted a beautiful landscape.

words.meaning: 초상화 (a painting or photo of a person's face)
words.example: The museum displays famous portraits.

words.meaning: 독특한, 유일한 (different from everything else)
words.example: Every person is unique.

words.meaning: 감정 (a strong feeling)
words.example: Music can express many emotions.
words.exampleKo: 음악은 많은 감정을 표현할 수 있다.

words.meaning: 작곡하다 (to write music)
words.example: Mozart composed many famous operas.

words.meaning: 기법, 기술 (a particular way of doing something)
words.example: She uses a special painting technique.

words.meaning: 추상적인 (not based on real things, expressing ideas)
words.example: I enjoy looking at abstract paintings.

words.meaning: 감상하다, 감사하다 (to enjoy or be thankful for something)
words.example: I appreciate your kindness.

words.meaning: 악기 (an object used to make music)
words.example: The violin is a string instrument.

words.meaning: 자신을 표현하다 (to show your thoughts or feelings)
words.example: Art helps children express themselves.
words.exampleKo: 예술은 아이들이 자신을 표현하는 데 도움이 된다.

words.meaning: 조각, 조각품 (a work of art made by shaping stone, metal, etc.)
words.example: The park is full of beautiful sculptures.

words.meaning: 시각의, 시각적인 (relating to seeing)
words.example: Movies are a visual art.

words.meaning: 미술관, 화랑 (a place where art is shown)
words.example: The gallery opens at ten a.m.

words.meaning: 조화, 화음 (a pleasing combination of sounds or things)
words.example: The colors are in perfect harmony.

words.meaning: 예술가, 화가 (someone who makes art)
words.example: She is a famous artist.

words.meaning: 영감 (something that gives you a new idea)
words.example: Nature is his greatest inspiration.

words.meaning: ~에 기반을 두다 (to be developed from something)
words.example: The movie is based on a true story.
words.exampleKo: 그 영화는 실화에 기반을 두고 있다.

words.meaning: ~으로 유명하다 (to be famous because of something)
words.example: The city is known for its beautiful beaches.

words.meaning: 눈에 띄다, 두드러지다 (to be easily seen or noticed)
words.example: Her red coat made her stand out in the crowd.
words.exampleKo: 그녀의 빨간 코트는 그녀를 군중 속에서 눈에 띄게 했다.

words.meaning: 걸작 (a work of art made with great skill)
words.example: The Mona Lisa is a world-famous masterpiece.

words.meaning: ~에서 영감을 받다 (to get new ideas from something)
words.example: The artist was inspired by the ocean.
